response.overview: The story of Loshe, a surfer from Ghana who turned the ocean into a collective sanctuary of healing and hope. In Cape Three Points, a remote village where life is traditionally defined by fishing and farming, Loshe discovered a different path within the waves. After finding personal solace in surfing, he has dedicated his life to mentoring local youth, fostering a deep sense of brotherhood through his grassroots surf school. By providing equipment and guidance, he offers these children a vital alternative to traditional labor, aiming to secure their education and a better future. The film captures how the bond between "brothers" can transform a generation and place Ghana on the global surfing map.
response.tagline: A story of falling and growing
response.title: Peace of Mind
